title: Phase 2: the caves at 4x, same seed, same camera zoom
question: Is this the size you meant by "caves should be bigger"? Specifically: is B's chamber about right, too much, or still not enough?
context_md:
`canyon` seed 1, the 8192x2560 world in both panes, `viewshot vault=1 scale=2` — the camera finds each world's own best cave and frames it, so this is the same world at the same zoom with only the cave constants differing.

**A** is what the 4x world looked like with round 7's cave sizes left alone. **B** is Phase 2: the cave envelope 4x, and the stalagmite/stalactite base width from 3-8 cells to 12-32.

What I already measured, over 8 seeds x 7 presets (`cave_probe`), so you do not need to judge it by eye:

- Cave void went from **0.591%** of the deep massif at the old 2048x640 world, to **0.041%** at 4x with the old cave sizes (pane A — five of eight worlds had no cave at all), back to **0.605%** in B. The handoff said a feature that stays the same size becomes "4x less significant"; measured it is fourteen times, because significance is area.
- Median formation base width 3 cells -> 11. That is the "1-2 pixels wide" complaint and I believe it is answered.

**What I am unsure of, and what I would like you to look at:** whether B is *too* big. Every cave in B is now at least 440 cells across — most of a screen — because I scaled the minimum along with the maximum. Small caves have gone. You asked for "a variety of sizes" as well as bigger, and I may have spent the variety.

**Please ignore** the honeycomb look of the passages branching off to the right in B. That is the Worley lattice and it is exactly what Phase 3 replaces; the handoff predicts Phase 2 alone makes it larger rather than better, and it did (disjoint walkable regions per system went from at most 5 to as many as 92).

items.label: A - 4x world, round-7 caves
